get.description:
Returns companies visible to the current user.

NOTE: This endpoint does not require the ['Procore-Company-Id' header]
(https://developers.procore.com/documentation/tutorial-mpz)
to be included on a request.

parameters.name: include_free_companies
parameters.description: When true, includes free companies that are otherwise excluded by default.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: When the value is the string `true`, returns all companies available to the user, including other zones and owners companies. Ignores `view` and returns the `with_owners_and_timed_out` shape.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response view for the company list. Defaults to `compact`. The 200 schema documents that default. Other values change which fields are returned.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.title: Company
items.description: Company visible to the current user.

pcn_business_experience.description: Whether Procore Construction Network business experience is enabled for the company.

my_company.description: Whether the current user is an active employee of this company. True for at most one company in a list response.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&include_free_companies=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&all=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.description:
Requests to List Companies with `view=with_root` now include `has_permissions_tool`.
It indicates whether the company has the Permissions tool active and available, which
distinguishes a company that has been upgraded from free to paid from one that is still
free — both keep `pcn_business_experience` set. The default view is unchanged.
